description: This file is a C header (.h) defining the exported API for the Bwsp Portal Host Object in the Broadway Web Service Plane Implementation. It contains function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling objects, and initializing the portal host, indicating it provides an interface for managing the portal host component.

methods.name: BwspCreatePortalHost
methods.description: Creates a portal host object with specified container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: BwspPhoCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Bwsp Portal Host object with specified contexts.

methods.name: BwspPhoRemove
methods.description: Removes or deallocates the specified portal host object.

methods.name: BwspPhoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls or registers objects related to the portal host object.
